title: Careful Claims
text:
Academic writers rarely state conclusions with complete certainty. Phrases such as the data suggest or it appears that allow a researcher to present findings without overstating them. Such hedges are not evasions; they signal the limits of the evidence and invite further testing. Readers who value precision often notice their absence more quickly than their presence.

Overuse of hedging, however, can make a text seem timid. A paper that qualifies every sentence may leave readers unsure of what the author actually believes. Skilled writers therefore place hedges where uncertainty genuinely exists and state well-supported claims plainly. The aim is calibration rather than caution for its own sake.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what do phrases like 'the data suggest' allow a researcher to do?
According to paragraph two, what can overuse of hedging make a text seem?
What can be inferred about readers who value precision?
options: They may notice the absence of hedges quickly

questions.text: What does the writer suggest the aim of hedging should be?
options: Calibration to the actual level of uncertainty

vocabulary.definition: words or phrases that qualify a claim and show caution
ways of avoiding a direct answer or statement
adjusting something so that it matches the actual level required

paragraph_translations: Los autores académicos rara vez presentan sus conclusiones con total certeza. Expresiones como the data suggest o it appears that permiten al investigador presentar resultados sin exagerarlos. Estas matizaciones no son evasiones; señalan los límites de la evidencia e invitan a seguir investigando. Los lectores que valoran la precisión suelen notar su ausencia con más rapidez que su presencia.

Sin embargo, el abuso de las matizaciones puede hacer que un texto parezca tímido. Un artículo que califica cada oración puede dejar a los lectores inseguros de lo que el autor realmente cree. Por eso, los escritores hábiles colocan las matizaciones donde la incertidumbre existe de verdad y expresan con claridad las afirmaciones bien respaldadas. El objetivo es la calibración, no la cautela por sí misma.
